additional_info.subject: Ticket creation – Persistent fault on Sicharge D charger (S/N Y2R0313281750001)
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Please create a service ticket for the Sicharge D charger, serial number Y2R0313281750001.
The charger is currently in fault with the following error message:
VendorErrorCode: DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 (DC CCS 160 kW connector unavailable).
An on-site intervention was already carried out about one month ago to resolve the same issue. However, the problem persists and the charger remains partially unavailable.
Given the recurring nature of this fault, an on-site intervention is mandatory to permanently resolve the issue.
Please let us know the next steps and the expected intervention timeline.
Best regards,
